title: Cross-Modal Adversarial Training for Multi-Modal Biometric Authentication: A Novel Framework for Robust Security

contributions.purpose: 跨模态对抗训练框架 CMAT
contributions.mechanism: 跨模态对抗样本生成 + 自适应融合层(按检测到的扰动动态调 α/β)+ 跨模态一致性损失
contributions.evaluation: 人脸/语音/行为三模态,合成 10,000 样本/100 用户
contributions.domain: 对抗机器学习/多模态生物认证
contributions.source_quote: Cross-Modal Adversarial Example Generation: A novel algorithm that generates adversarial examples across multiple modalities simultaneously, considering the interactions between different input channels.

contributions.mechanism: 与 ResNet-50/VGG-16/LSTM/简单拼接融合对比 + 消融

contributions.source_quote: achieving 15.3% improvement in cross-modal adversarial accuracy compared to existing methods
